messages:
oliver: quick heads-up — our example edge app started failing after installing @redwood/sdk@0.12.3. error from runtime: "Cannot find module '.../dist/index.cjs'". looks like the package shipped only .mjs and no cjs fallback.
sana: ouch. do you have the npm pack output or publish logs?
oliver: yes, here's the relevant ci output:
```
> npm publish (package/@redwood/sdk@0.12.3)
Included files:
 - dist/index.mjs
 - dist/index.d.ts
 - README.md
 - LICENSE
```
kevin: that explains it. package.json probably still lists "main":"dist/index.cjs" or exports expect require -> cjs. we've been switching to ESM outputs in tsup/rollup and forgot to update package.json.
siobhan: also check sourcemaps. some edge bundlers choke if sourceMappingURL points at .map that's not published. did index.mjs reference a map?
oliver: yep `//# sourceMappingURL=index.js.map` in the emitted file but dist didn't include any .map. npm pack omitted it due to package.files pattern.
sana: we saw this pattern before. root cause: package.json.files was too narrow (dist/*.mjs, dist/*.d.ts) and .npmignore suppressed others. plus pnpm pack in CI behaves slightly differently than npm pack locally.
kevin: immediate options:
1) republish a patch that updates package.json exports/main to point to dist/index.mjs (ESM-only), and include .map files in package.files OR
2) build a CJS artifact (dist/index.cjs) alongside the .mjs and keep both in exports so require() still works.
siobhan: prefer 1 if we don't want to ship CJS long-term. but that is a breaking change for some downstream repos using require. we should document it and warn in release notes.
oliver: i've opened a tiny PR that does the following:
- update package.json exports: map require/import to dist/index.mjs
- add dist/*.map to package.files
- add a pre-publish check in CI that runs `npm pack --dry-run --json` and asserts we have index.mjs + index.d.ts + index.js.map
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/438 (WIP)

dev-bot: CI: running npm-pack dry-run assertion for PR #438

sana: can we also add a smoke test to the sample-edge-app repo that runs a minimal import in an edge-like node environment? e.g. `node --input-type=module -e "import('@redwood/sdk').then(()=>console.log('ok'))"` so CI would catch resolution issues before publish.
kevin: yes, and add a lint that checks package.json.exports formats are consistent across packages in the monorepo. i can add a small script that scans packages and verifies files referenced by exports actually exist in dist.
siobhan: another note: add sourcemap publishing to the SDK publishing checklist in devex docs. tiny checklist items:
- main/exports correct
- types present (dist/index.d.ts)
- sourcemaps included if referenced
- run npm-pack dry-run in CI
- smoke import test for ESM/CJS

oliver: everyone ok if i bump to 0.12.4 once PR merges and you (kevin) trigger publish? i'm stepping away in ~20m.
kevin: i'll take the publish. after republish we should notify #support and update release notes with a clear migration note if we drop CJS fallback.
siobhan: also schedule a short audit ticket for other packages in the monorepo — the same package.files pattern exists in a few libs. i'll open the ticket and assign for triage.

dev-bot: PR #438 CI passed.
kevin: published @redwood/sdk@0.12.4 with exports fix and maps included. posting to #support.
oliver: verified sample-edge-app works locally with 0.12.4. closing loop. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
